resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Spanish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Spanish pass identified 25 actionable false-friend, grammar, register, thermal, circuit, and technical-clarity defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Spanish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The power paragraph translated heat-dissipation capability as thermal capacity and free space.
evidence: The previous text used suficiente capacidad térmica y espacio libre.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with capacidad de disipación térmica and a margen de seguridad.

findings.summary: The heating-power heading used a less precise heating term.
evidence: The previous title was Potencia de calentamiento.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Potencia térmica.

findings.summary: The coil setup used transporta for electrical current.
evidence: The previous setup was Una bobina de 0,8 Ω transporta 3 A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a coil conducting a 3 A current.

findings.summary: The heading used calefacción, which suggests building heating rather than electrical heating.
evidence: The previous title was ¿Qué afecta la calefacción?.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ¿Qué afecta al calentamiento?.

findings.summary: The heat-transfer bullet translated hardware as hardware instead of equipment.
evidence: The previous text referred to aire, líquido y hardware.
findings.resolution: Changed it to aire, líquido y equipos.

findings.summary: The paragraph needed the more precise areal heat-flow term and clearer surface-transfer wording.
evidence: The previous text used flujo de calor and described heat abandoning the surface.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with densidad de flujo térmico and natural Spanish.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph translated safety margin as physical clearance.
evidence: The previous text used Utilice un espacio libre adecuado.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with margen de seguridad adecuado.

findings.summary: The series-resistor conclusion used an unnatural plural subject.
evidence: The previous text was Los mismos 20 A pasan por ambas resistencias.
findings.resolution: Changed it to La misma corriente de 20 A pasa por ambas resistencias.

findings.summary: The parallel-resistor conclusion used transporta for current through a branch.
evidence: The previous text was cada rama transporta 10 A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to por cada rama circulan 10 A.

findings.summary: The battery-cell heading could state the connection relationship more naturally.
evidence: The previous title was Celdas en serie y paralelo.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Celdas conectadas en serie y paralelo.

findings.summary: The series-cell bullet used an unclear equivalent-cell phrase.
evidence: The previous text ended with la de una celda igual.
findings.resolution: Changed it to la de una celda equivalente.

findings.summary: The lithium-ion charging warning used an awkward literal phrase for series charging.
evidence: The previous text was La carga de iones de litio en serie.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as La carga en serie de celdas de ion-litio with cell-level supervision.

findings.summary: The circuit-solving title used a gerund that sounded like an incomplete instruction.
evidence: The previous title was Resolviendo circuitos reales.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Resolución de circuitos reales.

findings.summary: The final circuit-solving bullet switched to informal tú while the surrounding text uses formal usted.
evidence: The previous text began Resuelve las ecuaciones.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the formal Resuelva.

findings.summary: The triangle explanation needed clearer and less repetitive definitions of the sides and SOH-CAH-TOA.
evidence: The previous paragraph repeated side descriptions and used inconsistent phrasing.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with precise opposite, adjacent, hypotenuse, sine, cosine, and tangent definitions.

findings.summary: The efficiency percentage lacked Spanish spacing before the percent sign.
evidence: The previous text used 80%, contrary to the surrounding Spanish unit formatting.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 80 %.

findings.summary: The object/material heading used versus, which is less natural for a technical comparison.
evidence: The previous title was Objeto versus material.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Objeto y material.

findings.summary: The paragraph used pertenece a todo el objeto where refers to the complete object is clearer.
evidence: The previous text began La capacidad calorífica pertenece a todo el objeto.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with se refiere al objeto completo and natural grammar.

findings.summary: The conduction heading had an unnecessary trailing period.
evidence: The previous title was Conducción a través de una capa plana.
findings.resolution: Removed the trailing punctuation from the heading.

findings.summary: The radiation paragraph incorrectly capitalized the word after a semicolon.
evidence: The previous text used ; Las temperaturas.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ; las temperaturas and retained absolute-kelvin wording.

findings.summary: The practical-check bullet used an infinitive fragment instead of the formal instruction used elsewhere.
evidence: The previous bullet began Distinguir el flujo térmico.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the formal instruction Distinga.

findings.summary: The SI display name had an unnecessary trailing period.
evidence: The previous display name was El sistema SI y las medidas imperiales..
findings.resolution: Removed the trailing punctuation.

findings.summary: The resistance heading had an unnecessary trailing period.
evidence: The previous title was Calibre, área y resistencia..
findings.resolution: Removed the trailing punctuation.

findings.summary: The AWG paragraph capitalized La after a semicolon and used the less precise corriente segura universal.
evidence: The previous text contained ; La ampacidad también depende.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with la capacidad de corriente and natural punctuation.

findings.summary: The wire specification bullet used Asigne un nombre al sistema, an unnatural literal instruction.
evidence: The previous bullet was Asigne un nombre al sistema.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the direct technical instruction Indique el sistema.
